★ Request
Display K.S. Miracle (Gym Uniform)
* Shorts Color / Bib: "Unspecified", Bib Text: "Tracen Academy"

She may very well endanger herself. That danger will surely remain.
Even so—if her happiness lies along this path...
*HAHH, HAHH, HAHH, HAHH...!!*

Because I have a run I can be proud of,
that Trainer and I polished together up until today!

Dad, Mom! Doctor!
I could win... I won! Ahaha... I did it!! I took 1st place!!

Everyone, please watch.
Trainer, please watch me as well.
I was the fastest of them all——!!

You don't need to push yourself at all, you hear me?!
As long as you cross the finish line safely, that's all we—

I'm okay!
...I'll be just fine, Mom, Dad.

Looking at her shedding tears of pure clarity, a single thought fills my mind.
Unreservedly, unmistakably—

And then came the event meet's 1200m Turf race.
The lightning-fast sprint swiftly entered its final stretch—

I hear you looked after our daughter during training. Thanks to you,
she often told us she was in top shape... Thank you very much.

Here comes K.S. Miracle! K.S. Miracle is making her move!
K.S. Miracle unleashes a burst of speed! Will she take the lead as is?!
(Not yet! Don't let up yet! Not yet... More——!!)

I'm sorry... that feels a lot better now.
I've been a burden to you all the way to the end, haven't I?

The girls at Tracen Academy are all amazing.
I know today's race won't be an easy walk in the park.

Yet, enveloped in cheers fittingly described as a roar,
the very first thing her eyes caught was—
"This girl is living for this very purpose."

Without a word, I have her sit down and spray her likely feverish legs
with the cooling spray I had prepared.

It is dangerous, after all. In the race just now, she never slowed her pace
until the very, very end. ...Completely ignoring the toll on her own body.
Just then, an announcement called the racers to assemble—

Ah, Kei-chan, wait!
Um... please be careful out there, okay?
Eh?
Besides—

Ah, I'm sorry. I'm just so happy...!
...I wonder if I got through to them.

K.S. Miracle in the lead! K.S. Miracle in the lead!
With 200m remaining, she breaks away completely!! In front is K.S. Miracle!!

(Don't slow down! Faster! Faster! Even faster!
Do it! Even—fasterrrrr!!!!)
I will win. Without fail.

Because I have the legs I'm proud of,
given to me by Mom, Dad, the doctor... and everyone.

Look. Everyone... is smiling.
I made everyone happy. ...I—!

I guess it's about time. Well then, Dad, Mom, Doctor.
Trainer, too... I'm heading out now.

"I'm okay"... "Thank you."
I wonder... if my feelings reached them...!

They bowed their heads repeatedly in deep humility. To someone who had planned
to cast aside their role today, their straightforward gratitude stung painfully.

Trainer! Um, truly...
Truly, !!

Still, I'm going to win. I'll show them.
—After all, I am the fastest.

Please, no need to be modest. As you know, she is a girl with many concerns when it comes to running.
Thank you so much for supporting her both physically and emotionally.
That's why—
And finally, the day of the event meet arrived—
Ngh, ...AAAAAAAGHHHHH!!

I'm sorry to take up your time, Trainer.
I just really wanted to say hello to you...

A roar of cheers and applause erupted,
praising K.S. Miracle for her tremendous, breathtaking run.
If only I could make her smile like that once more.

With me...?
Trainer, does that mean—

(Because that's the greatest form of "thank you"
that I can possibly convey.)

—She crosses the line!! Wh-What a terrifying run by K.S. Miracle!
A staggering 9-length margin over 2nd place! Taking 1st place is K.S. Miracle!!
Phew—...!!

Ah, oh dear... I got way too carried away.
I have to get back—

She looked happier than in any other moment. Radiant and bursting with life.
Presenting a proud achievement to her benefactors, she wore a smile from the bottom of her heart.
